# `bus.logical_net.create`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/bus.logical_net.create.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`bus.logical_net.create` (`CreateLogicalNet`): a logical bus network, the scope of address uniqueness with its
master and rate (doc 10 §2.7, FR-BUS-002).

Creates `LogicalNet {bus, name, rate}` without a master (`fields.set` `master` sets it: a port's CP, or an
external interruption point whose external reference names a partner outside the project). Rejected: a name
another logical net has (compared exactly); a bus system of a newer format (at `/bus`); a rate of 0 (at
`/rate`). Outcome: the logical net.

## Parameters

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | [`BusSystem`](#bussystem) | yes |  | The bus system (`profibus_dp`). |
| `name` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | The name ("PROFIBUS DP"). |
| `rate` | [`BusRate`](#busrate) or `null` | no |  | The data rate in bit/s; absent: unset. |

## Types

### BusRate

A bus data rate in bit/s (FR-BUS-009: 9 600 to 12 000 000 for PROFIBUS DP), an integer like every number of
the format.

Type: integer (format `uint32`, min 0)

### BusSystem

A bus system (doc 10 §2.7).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"profibus_dp"` | PROFIBUS DP. |
| `"profinet"` | PROFINET IO. |
| `"ethercat"` | EtherCAT. |
| `"ethernet_ip"` | EtherNet/IP. |
| `"io_link"` | IO-Link. |
| `"asi"` | AS-Interface. |
| `"canopen"` | CANopen. |
| `"modbus_tcp"` | Modbus TCP. |

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
